how_derived: For every commit after 067c94c that touches docs/migration-frontier.json, each counter value the commit records differently from its parent, with the sentence its own body states the move in. at_report_tip holds those counters as 067c94c left them -- the values the close report's section 5 states -- and applying every movement in order must land on the tree's committed receipt. A merge is one such commit and records one row for the range it brings in, keyed by the merged-in tip rather than by a commit on this branch, because no single commit on either side moved the counter: the range did.
why_it_is_pinned: The chain is checkable against the tree without reading history: a counter that moves without a row here leaves docs/migration-frontier.json away from this ledger's endpoint, which is red on the commit that lands it. That was the property the walk over 067c94c..HEAD bought, and it cost the suite the whole repository on every run.

Nothing on this branch rounds anything new -- accumulate.py 1 and score_state.py 1 are unmoved, and counter_6.program_value is still 0, so program/precision.py is still the only registry. The work that drives 133 back down is unchanged in kind: fold transitions.py's per-write rounding into the end-of-walk projection precision.py owns.
